REVERSE_ARRAY.correct_py:
import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().split()
if lines:
    n = int(lines[0])
    arr = lines[1:n+1]
    print(' '.join(reversed(arr)))

FACTORIAL_CALC.correct_py:
import sys, math
line = sys.stdin.read().strip()
if line:
    n = int(line)
    print(math.factorial(n))

SORT_INTEGERS.correct_py:
import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().split()
if lines:
    n = int(lines[0])
    nums = sorted(list(map(int, lines[1:n+1])))
    print(' '.join(map(str, nums)))

MAX_SUBARRAY_SUM.correct_py:
import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().split()
if lines:
    n = int(lines[0])
    nums = list(map(int, lines[1:n+1]))
    max_so_far = current_max = nums[0]
    for x in nums[1:]:
        current_max = max(x, current_max + x)
        max_so_far = max(max_so_far, current_max)
    print(max_so_far)
